S0C7.name: Data exception
S0C7.meaning: A numeric field contains invalid data, such as spaces or garbage in a packed decimal (COMP-3) field.
first_checks: Look at the input file for non-numeric data in numeric fields
Find the failing offset in the dump and match it to the compile listing
Check for uninitialized working-storage fields

S0C4.name: Protection exception
S0C4.meaning: The program tried to use storage it doesn't own, often a subscript out of range or a bad pointer.
first_checks: Check table subscripts and array bounds
Check that the calling program passes the right parameters
Check that the REGION size is large enough

S0C1.name: Operation exception
S0C1.meaning: The program tried to execute something that isn't a valid instruction, often a bad call to a missing or wrong module.
first_checks: Check that the called module exists and was linked correctly
Look for a recent recompile or relink of the program

S806.name: Module not found
S806.meaning: The system could not find the program in STEPLIB, JOBLIB or the link list.
first_checks: Check the program name for typos in the EXEC statement
Check that the load library is in STEPLIB or JOBLIB
Check that the module was actually promoted to this environment

S322.name: Time limit exceeded
S322.meaning: The job or step ran longer than its TIME limit, sometimes because of an infinite loop.
first_checks: Compare the run time to previous runs of the same job
Check whether the input volume was unusually large
Look for a loop condition that never ends

SB37.name: Out of space (volume)
SB37.meaning: The output dataset ran out of space on the volume.
first_checks: Increase the SPACE allocation in the DD statement
Check whether the output was much larger than usual

SD37.name: Out of space (no secondary)
SD37.meaning: The primary space was used up and no secondary space was specified.
first_checks: Add a secondary allocation to the SPACE parameter
Check whether the input volume grew

SE37.name: Out of space (end of volume)
SE37.meaning: The dataset needed more extents or volumes than were available.
first_checks: Increase the space or the number of volumes
Ask the storage team to check free space on the volume

S013.name: Open error
S013.meaning: The dataset could not be opened, often because the DCB attributes don't match or a member is missing.
first_checks: Compare RECFM, LRECL and BLKSIZE between the program and the dataset
Check that the PDS member name exists

S913.name: Security violation
S913.meaning: The job's user ID is not authorized to access the dataset.
first_checks: Check the RACF access for the job's user ID on that dataset
Check whether the dataset name or the user ID changed recently

S878.name: Insufficient virtual storage
S878.meaning: The step needed more memory than the REGION allowed.
first_checks: Increase the REGION parameter on the JOB or EXEC statement
Check whether the input volume grew

S222.name: Job cancelled
S222.meaning: The job was cancelled by an operator or the system, not by the program itself.
first_checks: Check the operator log for who cancelled it and why
Check whether the job was running past its expected window
